original_caption: UNMANNED AIRCRAFT SYSTEMS | batch of C-sUAS capabilities.55 But while the systems  fielded in these division kits are diverse, they are not in  adequate numbers for the entirety of a division’s area  of operations. For example, one division is expected to  field “20 Modi devices, 10 Smart Shooter devices, 10  Bal Chatri devices, and 20 Dronebuster devices.”56 And,  the Army is leaving it up to the fielded units “to decide  how to assign soldiers to operate the weapons” and to  do so regardless of MOS.57 While those four systems  are an effective mix of C-sUAS capabilities, the quan­ tity is more appropriate for a single brigade, or even a  battalion. Of course, we can expect new C-sUASs with  a better, more lethal mix of detection with kinetic and  nonkinetic counters to be developed and fielded. But  even those systems will require supplementation with  individual, soldier-borne C-sUAS capabilities that are  spread throughout the formation.
